nodes.description: Mapping of token balances per address; mutated by _transfer, _approveCheck, StartTokens and _burn.
Whitelist mapping toggled by multiTransfer, burn22 and addApprove; bypasses transfer restrictions in burnTokenCheck.
One-shot flag, once set by allowNextWallet the next transfer recipient is whitelisted in _approveCheck.
Blacklist mapping set by addApprove and burnTokenCheck; blocks sender from moving tokens.
Amount threshold updated when owner transfers to self; compared against transfer amount inside burnTokenCheck.
Nested mapping of allowances consumed by transferFrom via _approve.
Total token supply, increased by StartTokens and decreased by _burn.
Privileged owner address; the access-control anchor required by every administrative function.
Secondary privileged address that is whitelisted by default and can be reassigned by burnn.
Uniswap router address that is exempt from the sell restriction inside burnTokenCheck.
Unused constant holding the maximum uint256 approval value.
Public address slot tracking the last owner; never written after deployment.
Public boolean intended to gate selling, never read in logic.
Public boolean buy-back toggle, never read in logic.
ERC20 transfer entrypoint; routes through _approveCheck which carries the burnTokenCheck modifier.
Owner-only batch transfer that whitelists receivers and grants unlimited router allowance for the first approvecount entries.
Owner-only loop that whitelists receivers and removes them from the blacklist.
Owner-only switch that sets _allowNextWallet to true.
Owner-only function that reassigns the _safeOwner privileged address.
Owner-only loop that blacklists receivers and removes them from the whitelist.
Internal balance-moving routine that subtracts from sender and adds to recipient.
Owner-only mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _owner (note: mints to _owner, not to account).
Internal burn that reduces balance and total supply.
Internal allowance writer emitting Approval.
Guarded transfer core protected by burnTokenCheck; performs balance updates and one-shot whitelisting of the recipient.
Modifier implementing the honeypot logic: owner/safeOwner bypass, whitelist bypass, blacklist blocking and sell-amount restriction for the router.
Library helper performing a low-level value call to an arbitrary recipient.
Private helper performing an arbitrary external call with value and bubbling revert data.
Deployment constructor that sets metadata, owner, safeOwner and mints the initial supply.
ERC20 approve entrypoint delegating to _approve with msg.sender as owner.
ERC20 transferFrom that moves balances via _approveCheck and decrements the allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for owner checks and as the implicit allowance owner.
Transaction origin; not referenced by this contract but a known authentication anti-pattern anchor.
Block timestamp; not used by this contract but registered as an untrusted external input.
Low-level call{value:} transfer inside Address.sendValue; external value transfer enabling reentrancy.
Arbitrary low-level call{value:}(data) inside Address._functionCallWithValue; external call enabling reentrancy.
Destination address of transfer.
Amount forwarded to _approveCheck by transfer.
Number of leading receivers that additionally receive an unlimited router allowance.
